schedule.collection_start: first actual invocation, not retroactively specified
schedule.missingness: unobserved nominal slots from first invocation, using actual run start; no reconstructed scheduler events

forecast.target_start: first UTC half-hour start >= body_receipt_at + 86400 seconds
forecast.issued_at_semantics: local body receipt time; provider issue time unavailable
forecast.selection: first valid locally captured vintage per exact target interval
forecast.duplicates: archive receipt but preserve original forecast record
forecast.numeric_validation: finite nonnegative int/float; boolean and null rejected

outcome.meaning: official estimated national average carbon intensity, not final or marginal emissions
outcome.selection: first received non-null valid actual at or after maturity
outcome.revision_policy: separate immutable records; first mature resolution never replaced
outcome.missing_policy: remain unresolved; expire beyond monitoring window; no synthetic labels

transport.read_deadline_caveat: checked between reads; one pending read can last to socket timeout
transport.retry_after: retained in evidence; scheduled owner must honor longer provider pause

evidence.public_commitment: verify public GitHub commit timestamp separately against target
